comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: As you said, maps usually drop items like amulets only once. But the quest you refer to (visible on this page if you click Another Info #1) is repeatable and farmable as I recall, just remember to do another quest afterward to reset as it is not possible to do the same quest twice in a row. Cheers, great online voyaging to you.
